cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
python3 - <<'PY'
s=open('finite_spectral_shadows.tex').read()
old="""The proof program is a four-budget row-sum decomposition: $R_{\\mathrm I}=0$
(proved, exact vanishing); $R_{\\mathrm{III}}$ explicit (locked-prefix
collision mass $\\Delta_0^{\\,c-1}$ times damped last-symbol multiplicity);
$R_{\\mathrm{IV}}$ subordinate by the degenerate-minimum audit (mass
treatment valid precisely at $m=c$); and the class-II budget, whose
\\emph{count} is now proved geometrically thin
(\\cref{thm:cascade,lem:cascade}) with sums capped by the two-point profile
(\\cref{prop:twopoint})---what remains open is the assembly past the
marginal coincidence on adversarially aligned rows
(see the assembly-status remark). The
$m=2c$ singular-value decay (rate $\\approx0.70$) is real but not presently
accessible to absolute-value bookkeeping; the threshold $m=c$ is the regime
where completeness first appears while endpoint matching still suppresses
degenerate nonstationary pairs. Empirical scale: $1-\\delta\\approx0.97$ at
$c=8$, descending. The uniform-$s$ extension is a subsequent target. This is
a fixed-power operator-norm statement---outside the scope of the trace
ceiling (\\cref{rem:sixth})---and it implies $\\sup_c\\gamma_c(0)<1$ directly.
\\end{conjecture}"""
new="""\\emph{Status of the four budgets (updated).} $R_{\\mathrm I}=0$ is proved
(exact vanishing); the cascade budget $R_{\\mathrm{II/III}}$ is
\\emph{proved} contractive unconditionally
(\\cref{lem:pinning,prop:rowcontract} with the bounded-shell theorem
\\cref{op:flat}), at rate $(\\sqrt3/2)^c$; the class-IV budget reduces to
the one-condition degeneracy cost (\\cref{op:onecond} below), which is the
sole remaining estimate; the tail is handled by a branch cutoff. The
$m=2c$ singular-value decay (rate $\\approx0.70$) is real but not
accessible to absolute-value bookkeeping; the threshold $m=c$ is the
regime where completeness first appears while endpoint matching still
suppresses degenerate nonstationary pairs. The uniform-$s$ extension is a
subsequent target. This is a fixed-power operator-norm statement---outside
the scope of the trace ceiling (\\cref{rem:sixth})---and it implies
$\\sup_c\\gamma_c(0)<1$ directly; see \\cref{thm:final}.
\\end{conjecture}"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
old2="""budget subordinate by audit. The flattening
input is now \\emph{proved} (\\cref{op:flat}: bounded shells,
$\\tilde Q_L\\le3C_1<5.16$, by the digit-extension energy argument), so the
cascade sector of the threshold Schur bound is an unconditional theorem
(\\cref{op:cascade}); the live finite-side remainder is the class-IV
(degenerate) row budget, audited subordinate, together with small-$c$
verification."""
new2="""budget subordinate by audit. The flattening
input is \\emph{proved} (\\cref{op:flat}: bounded shells,
$\\tilde Q_L\\le3C_1<5.16$, by the digit-extension energy argument), so the
cascade sector of the threshold Schur bound is an unconditional theorem
(\\cref{op:cascade}); and the full finite H23a operator theorem
$\\sup_c\\gamma_c(0)<1$ is now proved \\emph{conditional on a single local
estimate} (\\cref{thm:final}): the one-condition degeneracy cost
\\cref{op:onecond}, whose ingredients (nominal-shell mass, leading
coefficient structure, singleton rigidity) are themselves proved
(\\cref{lem:nomshell,lem:leadcoeff}), with the level-cost law measured at
$0.13,\\,0.30,\\,0.33$ uniformly over shells. Small $c$ is covered by the
strict gap (\\cref{cor:strict}) and finiteness---no certified numerics
needed for the qualitative statement."""
assert "budget subordinate by audit. The flattening" in s
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
open('finite_spectral_shadows.tex','w').write(s)
print("ok")
PY
pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode finite_spectral_shadows.tex >/tmp/fss.log 2>&1; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode finite_spectral_shadows.tex >/tmp/fss.log 2>&1
grep -E "^!" /tmp/fss.log | head -3; pdfinfo finite_spectral_shadows.pdf | grep Pages

(2) LEMMA leading coefficient (lem:leadcoeff): Lambda = sum_{i in I} delta_i*nu_i mod 3 (delta=leading digit of dC_i, nu=(C_iC'_i)^{-1}); (i) criterion d_true >= d_nom+1 <=> Lambda=0; (ii) Lambda INDEPENDENT OF a (3^i a = 0 mod 3) => first degeneracy level = pure word-pair event; (iii) SINGLETON RIGIDITY: |I|=1 => Lambda != 0 - degeneracy REQUIRES collision of minima (resolves dc_27 sec 9 structural-zero worry in the strongest form). AUDIT (classIV_levelcost.py, c=7, 2M pairs): a-independence EXACT (0 mixed cases); P[h>=1|d] = 0.13 uniform over d=3..6, EXACTLY 0 at singleton shell d=2 (889k pairs); conditionals P[h>=2|h>=1]=0.302, P[h>=3|h>=2]=0.333 - level-cost law confirmed per-shell. OPEN (op:onecond - the SOLE remaining finite-side estimate): one-condition degeneracy cost <= (1/3)(1+eps_r) under terminal filtration, cellwise in a => P[h>=r] <= C2*3^{-r}; analogue of the op:flat class-bijectivity step. CONDITIONAL THEOREM (thm:final - FINITE H23a): granted op:onecond: R_IV <= phi*mu*sum_d K3^{-(d-2)}C2 3^{-(c-1-d)} <= poly*3^{-c/2} (far subordinate; uses cellwise coset dichotomy |S| <= degenerate-cell measure + mu <= sqrt(Col) from op:flat) => sup_xi R_c <= poly(sqrt3/2)^c => ||T^c||^{1/c} <= 3^{1/4}/sqrt2 ~ 0.9306 => with cor:strict for the finitely many c < c0: SUP_C GAMMA_C(0) < 1, NO certified numerics needed for qualitative statement. conj:schur budgets-status rewritten (class II/III closed per dc_27 sec 13B); conclusion final-state updated. REMAINING: op:onecond (one local mod-3 estimate) + optional s in [0,1] + explicit delta; keystone separate." 2>&1 | tail -1
